name: fluid-flow
full_name: Fracture-Flow (Flow Knot / Flow Plane) FISH Intrinsics
description: Pointer-based FISH access to 3DEC's fracture-flow network used in hydro-mechanical coupling — flow knots (nodal points) and flow planes (planar fracture-flow elements).

notes: flowknot.pp is the pore pressure at the knot. CORRECTION (live 3DEC 9.7.47): flowknot.head is the LIST-HEAD iterator (flowknot_pnt = flowknot.head()), NOT a hydraulic-head value - there is no hydraulic-head intrinsic; derive head from pp and elevation if needed.
A flow plane couples to the mechanical joint via 'flowplane.contact'.

verification: Live-verified 2026-08-14 against 3DEC 9.7.47: all documented flowknot.*/flowplane.* names confirmed present (incl. flowplane.vertexlist / flowplane.zonelist); flowknot.head semantics corrected.
